VITAL VR - ambient audio provenance
Verified 2026-10-02. All external ambient assets below are CC0 1.0.
License: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Original source bytes retained. Unity imports mono 22.05 kHz Vorbis; quiet spatial sources and loop crossfades are applied during playback.
Freesound assets use their publicly available HQ previews; no account was needed.
